# eval_three_groups fixture

Minimal portable batches for `test_eval_aggregate.py`: a v2 case-table batch with real role events, a v2 trial batch with placeholder role events (tokens not recorded), and a plain-llm control group in the format written by `eval_baseline_plain_llm.py`. The v1 group comes from `test/fixtures/eval_screening/gpt_oss20b`.
